verdict.rationale: Marlin's docs say it generates a detailed, fully referenced strategy report of up to a hundred pages. The report has a main body, appendices and references, plus executive summary slides in PowerPoint meant for executive review, which covers the sections, summary and stakeholder-sharing core of the story. Tables are never mentioned, and all evidence is vendor marketing. missing for 10: explicit evidence of tables in the report, documented share/export formats beyond PowerPoint slides, independent or hands-on corroboration of output structure.

support.subject: As an analyst, I can get a structured report with sections, tables, and a summary that I can share with stakeholders
